crossRefs.note: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that…
When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”
